a: $1M to $1.3M over 3 yrs; supports high-risk work and custom instrumentation
dt: Application due Dec 7, 2026, 4:30 pm PT (June 2027 grant cycle); the next deadline is Jun 7, 2027, 4:30 pm PT (December 2027 cycle). Yale internal selection comes earlier.
e: Limited to 3 applications per institution; goes through Yale's internal competition.
n: W.M. Keck Foundation Research Program (Science & Engineering)

yale.t: Keck is limited-submission (3 applications per institution per cycle); Yale runs internal competitions through InfoReady (yale.infoready4.com, Organizer filter = Limited Submissions), generally due about 12 weeks before the sponsor deadline. Yale holds a Keck Research Program info session on Dec 9, 2026 (registration required; posted on the InfoReady bulletin board). Contact internal.proposals@yale.edu.
yale.unv: The info session date comes from the Yale Funding Opportunities newsletter of Nov 18, 2026; the InfoReady posting needs a Yale login. No internal deadline for the Jun 7, 2027 round is posted yet; timing inferred from Yale's general 12-week rule.
